baseline: width 1; beta .4; eta 0; M0 identity or M1 identity knots; M2 correction0; rho0
otherStarts: 15 uniform over the full bounded optimization coordinate box
monotoneMap: sort eight [0,255] optimization coordinates, keeping all eight

hardRails.method: LS seed then SLSQP constrained LS

minimax.method: independent-original-start SLSQP epigraph of bin/channel mean absolute pixel error
minimax.refinement: each LS result seeds a second SLSQP epigraph solve at the same maxiter/ftol; retain raw and refined results; choose only forward-feasible converged candidates
minimax.zeroFloorBracket: a forward-feasible upper <=1e-8 codes may be selected with the exact objective floor0; optimizerSuccess/converged remain unchanged, never relabelled; report bracket separately

rank: finite difference of raw uncensored predictions; all singular values; width quadrature plateaus not regularized
mass: equal cell, equal measured bin/channel group within cell, equal uncensored pixel within group; rail constraints hard
authority: LOCAL; optimizer failure or rail/epigraph failure is not a family negative
scope: array API only; caller admits calibration roles/populations and holds shadow; no archive reader
amendment: P2 width-plateau repair, synthetic only and before any native fit: retain the original 16 results; add bounded alternating derivative-free width/coefficient search. The fixed 16x16 forward quadrature, parameter domains, equal mass and exact rails are unchanged.

widthSearch.method: conditional width sweep then local refinement, alternating with fixed-width coefficient solves for LS and minimax separately
widthSearch.selection: include incumbent; ascending grid, strict improvement only; reject widths violating any hard rail; refine +/- preceding spacing about the best width, clipped to declared bounds
widthSearch.coefficientBudget: same 3000 max_nfev/maxiter and 1e-10 tolerances as original solves; freeze width by eliminating it from solver coordinates
widthSearch.minimaxSeed: best valid original/LS-seeded minimax and a new epigraph solve from width-aware LS, retaining both; alternate from the better valid candidate
widthSearch.termination: objective at floor, no admissible width improvement, coefficient rejection, or eight-round budget; report reason, sweeps and every coefficient optimizer result
widthSearch.authority: LOCAL coordinate search; neither grid nor coefficient stationarity is a global certificate; narrow basins, coupled width/colour barriers and infeasible crossings can be missed; converged still means numerical coefficient optimizer plus forward feasibility/epigraph, not width identification
